notes.title: 1.1.1 Bug Fixing Patch
notes.content:
-Fixed bug soft locking the game upon entering the adult section's entrance during a chase.
-Fixed bug where Mitch's graphics would be glitched after escaping from the theater.
-Fixed bug where only one area of the sink would open the costume menu.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Unlocked costumes can now be worn via the bathroom sink while no chase is active.
An overworld sprite for the fire extinguisher has been added.
Reading the Motel Note from the inventory will now display the correct note.
Minor spelling and grammar fixes
Added dialogue when using soda in an unusable location.
The “Foolish Fantasy” tape can now be properly viewed in Graves mode.
All usable items can now be shown to certain friendly characters.
Achievement added for secret ending.
Achievement added for new item interaction.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Patch
notes.content:
Using the puzzle block on the plant no longer results in the stove death.
A manual is now included within the game folder.
Unlocking the flesh conservatory now prompts a text box.
The Handle Doll stands out more.
The location containing the scissors stands out more.
Upon starting a new game, a notice about the autosave feature is given.
Certain elements on the felt wall now have full examination menus.
The clown doll now has a full examination menu.
Fixed strange item interactions on Pietro
The rope can now be used while in the clock’s close up view
Fixed issue allowing players to cut the same puppet down twice in the final part of the play section.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed issue with certain fonts
- Event involving the vents no longer prevents manual saving
